final_payload.rationale_summary: After normalizing the treasury yields to the same metric, unit, and period basis, the change from as of 2003-02-10 to as of 2003-02-11 was -0.03, while the change from as of 2003-02-11 to as of 2003-02-12 was -0.08. The higher change was therefore as of 2003-02-10–as of 2003-02-11, with a difference of 0.05 between the two changes.
